blocks.h: Living in Dubai, Singapore or Paris? Your Pondicherry property is in safe hands.
blocks.p: Rent collected on time, tenants checked, bills paid and a video walk-through every month — without asking relatives for favours again. Start with a free property check: we visit, film the whole property and send you a written report in three working days.
blocks.note: For owners in the Gulf, Singapore, Malaysia, Europe and beyond. We call at your time, not ours.

blocks.h: Selling? Find out what your property is actually worth first.
blocks.p: Price it too low and you lose lakhs. Price it too high and it sits unsold for a year. Our free valuation is built from registrations and deals in your own street, not guesswork.

items.q: Do you charge anything to start?
items.a: No. Valuations, property checks and document reviews are free. Our brokerage is 2% of the property value up to ₹1 crore and 1% above that, payable only after registration.

items.q: Can you manage my property while I'm abroad?
items.a: Yes — this is a large part of our work. We handle tenants, rent collection, bills and maintenance, and send you a monthly report with photos and video. The fee is 10% of the rent we collect, plus GST.

items.q: How do I receive rent if I live outside India?
items.a: Rent is transferred to your NRO account after the applicable TDS. We share statements and receipts every month; your CA can reconcile them at year end.

items.q: Do you handle registration and documents?
items.a: We coordinate the entire process — verification, drafting with your lawyer, the sub-registrar appointment and handover.

items.q: Do you sell your own layouts?
items.a: Yes. We develop residential and investment layouts around Pondicherry. Ask us what is open right now.
